class.name: MaszynaLegacyEventCondition
class.brief_description: The original's event [code]condition[/code] and a launcher's memcell condition.
class.description: [code]probability[/code], [code]trackoccupied[/code], [code]trackfree[/code], [code]memcompare[/code] and [code]memcompareex[/code] (event_conditions, [code]Event.cpp:44-254[/code]; [code]EvLaunch.cpp:100-130, 216-227[/code]). Every memory has to pass; a memory passes as its [member pass] mode combines the masked fields compared ([code]TMemCell::Compare()[/code], [code]MemCell.cpp:130-185[/code]), a text with a [code]*[/code] compared up to it. [code]memcompare[/code] is all fields [code]==[/code].
